title: Context and memory in the makerspace assistant

items.stem: On Tuesday a student tells the assistant, "I'm allergic to resin." On Wednesday the student starts a new session and asks which printing materials are safe. What lets the assistant take the allergy into account?

options.text: The model still holds Tuesday's chat from when it was last used
The model was retrained overnight on all of Tuesday's conversations
The program saved a note on Tuesday and puts it into Wednesday's window
The model's context window is simply large enough to cover both days

items.stem: One request makes four model calls. A tool result of 2,000 tokens arrives after call 1, so it is part of the history in calls 2, 3 and 4. Option A keeps it in full in all three calls. Option B keeps it in full in call 2, then replaces it with a 50-token note in calls 3 and 4. How many fewer tokens does option B send in total across the three calls? (All numbers invented.)

A student asks, "How do I change the blade on the band saw?" The search over the manuals returns a chunk that reads "Release the tension, then remove it carefully." The chunk is correct but it is ranked low, and other chunks are returned instead. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The manuals were cut into chunks that are far too long
The chunk never names the band saw or the blade
The model's context window was already completely full
The chunk was saved in a note file by mistake

items.stem: At the end of a session the assistant can save either a one-line note about the student or the whole chat. In one or two sentences, why is the one-line note the better choice for later sessions?
Each request makes five model calls. On call 2 the assistant loads a 10,000-token manual page, and it is used once, on call 3. Which single change cuts the most tokens per request?

options.text: Replace the page with a one-line note once it is used
Save the whole page as a note for the next session
Shorten the instructions by about fifty tokens a call
Move to a model with a much larger context window
